heading: congregation

heading: congregation

heading: congregation

heading: congregation

heading: congregation

heading: congregation

heading: congregation

heading: congregation

heading: congregation

heading: congregation

以色列頌: 認識救恩；
heading: congregation

heading: congregation

heading: congregation

heading: congregation

以色列頌: 把我們的腳引到和平的路上。
heading: congregation

heading: congregation
